changelog: Fixes recall of notes you've kept private. When you vault a note (🔒), it now stays off any cloud brain on your desktop too — and the assistant answers it on-device with its full contents instead of quietly dropping it and replying 'I don't have that'. If you ask about a vaulted note without on-device AI installed, it tells you plainly rather than guessing. Typed notes also show as 'Note' (not 'Meeting'), and manually syncing a note now gives clear confirmation.
